steps.answer: DBS Altitude Card (Visa Signature and American Express variants) is DBS's primary travel miles card. Key features: Earn up to 2.2 miles per S$1 on overseas spend (in foreign currency), 1.3 miles per S$1 on local spend. Miles for Life – DBS Points earned do not expire. Welcome gift: Samsonite MINTER 80/30 Trunk Luggage (worth S$680) or up to 38,000 miles. Also available: DBS Vantage Visa Infinite Card (switch between 2.2 miles/S$1 or 2.2% cashback, with Accor Plus Explorer membership and Priority Pass).

steps.answer: DBS offers multiple home loan options: (1) DBS HDB Home Loan - rates lower than HDB Concessionary Loan (from 1.78% p.a.), no penalty fees for early partial repayment, complimentary LPA certification. (2) DBS Private Home Loan - competitive rate packages, up to S$1,200 shopping voucher rewards, online pre-approval within minutes. (3) Refinance Your Home Loan - competitive interest rates, up to S$4,000 cash rewards. (4) DBS Green Home Loan - preferential rates for Green Mark-certified properties, FHR6 or 3M SORA packages. Other loans include Renovation Loan (3.38% p.a.), Cash-out Loan, Commercial & Industrial Property Loan, and Home Equity Income Loan (fixed 3.88% p.a.).

steps.answer: To make an overseas transfer via DBS digibank: Pre-transfer checklist: gather recipient's Bank Name, Account Number, Full Name, and Address. Steps via digibank mobile: (1) Log in with Touch/Face ID or User ID & PIN; (2) Tap 'Pay & Transfer' and select 'Overseas'; (3) Select recipient; (4) Select account, enter amount and purpose; (5) Review and tap 'Transfer now'; (6) Transfer submitted. Also available via digibank Online and DBS/POSB Branches. Service covers 200+ markets in 19+ currencies. An eAdvice is sent to registered email upon success.

steps.answer: To get started with investing through DBS: (1) DBS digiWealth - start with ready-made portfolios professionally managed by DBS CIO, invest from S$100 with zero sales charges on Regular Savings Plans, track portfolio and total net worth in one app. (2) Trade with DBS Vickers - access 7 global markets (SG, US, HK, CAD, UK, AUS, JP), reduced online commissions on cash upfront trades. (3) Equity Products - apply for DBS Vickers account, multi-currency account linkage for seamless settlement. (4) Funds - invest in mutual funds. (5) Singapore Government Securities (SGS Bonds/T-Bills). Resources: 'Need help getting started?' section with New to Investing guides, investment tips, user guides, and articles.
